WITH 
-- Get all districts within 50 km of Lucknow
districts AS (
    SELECT 
        id,
        names."primary" AS name,
        subtype,
        region,
        ST_Distance(geometry, ST_MakePoint('Lucknow', 21.00, 77.50)) AS dist_km
    FROM divisions_area
    WHERE subtype IN ('county')
    AND ST_DWithin(geometry, ST_MakePoint('Lucknow', 21.00, 77.50), 50)
),
-- Get the 3 largest districts by distance
top3 AS (
    SELECT 
        id,
        name,
        ST_AsGeoJSON(geometry) AS geometry
    FROM districts
    ORDER BY dist_km DESC
    LIMIT 3
)
SELECT 
    id,
    name AS name,
    ST_AsGeoJSON(geometry) AS geometry
FROM top3;
